product_one_liner.value: Aikido is a developer-first security platform for engineering and security teams that secures code, cloud, and runtime to reduce software risk without slowing development.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists pricing plans, including a free Developer plan.

named_customers.notes: Aikido’s press kit identifies these organizations in its global customer base.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Ghent as headquarters; the registered headquarters address is in Belgium.

founded_year.notes: Aikido states it was founded in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The Engineering index includes technical posts on deterministic scanning and AutoTriage; Aikido also publishes a technical account of its open-weight model and infrastructure by its Machine Lead Engineer. Dania Durnas, author of the scanning post, is identified as a former backend software engineer and developer-content writer.

public_docs.notes: Aikido maintains a public documentation/help center with multiple product and integration articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Aikido’s recruiting page lists an AI Engineer role.

model_provider.value: AWS Bedrock is used to host AI models for AutoFix code fixes; Aikido also lists OpenAI Developer API, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure for AI inference.
model_provider.notes: The AWS Bedrock statement is specifically about generating AutoFix fixes; the other providers are listed on Aikido’s subprocessors page for AI inference.

compliance_certs.notes: These names appear on Aikido’s Trust Center; other listed standards not requested here are omitted.

last_funding.notes: Aikido announced a $60 million Series B in January 2026. PitchBook’s profile in the prior research reports a different deal amount ($70.3 million), so the amount here follows Aikido’s public announcement.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 2026 Series B was raised within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live recruiting pages list a Business Development Representative and an Account Executive Enterprise role. These postings were verified on November 10, 2026, one day after the question’s stated reference date.

launched_6mo.notes: Aikido introduced its Altar open-weight security model on September 21, 2026; the blog index also lists the October 2026 launch of Noon.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jeff Poczatek’s profile lists a VP Sales role at Aikido beginning February 1, 2026, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Aikido’s BDR posting names HubSpot as its CRM and lists LinkedIn and Outreach/Salesloft among its sales tooling.
